name: Dungeon Battles
summary:
Dungeon Battles is a dark-fantasy browser role-playing game that combines village building, resource management, and character progression. Players develop a settlement, fight monsters in turn-based combat, craft and trade equipment, and compete against others in ranked arena battles.

The game runs in a web browser with no download. Players can progress solo or with a clan through cooperative boss raids and clan wars. A live Twitch mode lets viewers join the current fight from chat.
